description: Effective TCP port of the tariff-calc service in the eu-west environment, across the fleet baseline and the environment file. WORKBANK-CANARY-3a7f2c9d

files.README.md:
# Tariff platform deploy workspace

config/defaults.yaml holds the fleet baseline settings that apply to every
service. environments/<env>.env carries the values the deployer injects for
the environment it is bringing up; when an environment file provides a
setting, that is the value the environment runs with.

The release train notes live under ops/.
files.config/defaults.yaml:
# Fleet baselines applied before an environment file is layered in.
meter-bridge:
  request_timeout_seconds: 30
  retry_attempts: 3
  poll_interval_seconds: 8
tariff-calc:
  request_timeout_seconds: 25
  retry_attempts: 5
files.environments/eu-west.env:
# Values the deployer injects when bringing up eu-west.
DEPLOY_ENV=eu-west
TARIFF_CALC_PORT=7714
METER_BRIDGE_PORT=6420
DB_POOL=32
LOG_LEVEL=warn
files.ops/release-train.md:
# Release train notes

The eu-west fleet was moved to the 2026.8 train after the June capacity
review. Rollback windows are listed in the on-call handover sheet.
